CLAIMS
Claim 1. A module robot comprising: a first link; a second link movably linked to the first link; and a fluid pressure cylinder configured to move the first link and the second link relative to each other, wherein the first link has a cylinder block in which a cylinder chamber of the fluid pressure cylinder is formed.
Claim 2. The module robot according to claim 1, wherein the module robot is configured by coupling a plurality of modules, the modules each has the first link, the second link, and the fluid pressure cylinder, and two of the modules are coupled by connecting the first link or the second link of a first module with the first link or the second link of a second module, the first module being one of the two modules, and the second module being other of the two modules.
Claim 3. The module robot according to claim 2, wherein the cylinder block of the first module is connectable with the first link or the second link of the second module.
Claim 4. The module robot according to claim 1, wherein the module robot is configured of a plurality of modules, the modules being formed so as to be partially integrated.
Claim 5. The module robot according to claim 1, wherein the fluid pressure cylinder is a liquid pressure cylinder, and a pump port connectable to a liquid pressure source and a tank port connectable to a tank are formed in at least two surfaces among a plurality of outer surfaces of the cylinder block.
Claim 6. The module robot according to claim 5, wherein the cylinder block is formed with a passage configured to connect the pump port and the tank port with the cylinder chamber.
Claim 7. The module robot according to claim 2, wherein the fluid pressure cylinder is a liquid pressure cylinder, a pump port connectable to a liquid pressure source and a tank port connectable to a tank are formed in at least two surfaces among a plurality of outer surfaces of the cylinder block, and the module further has: a state-quantity detector configured to detect a state quantity of the module; a control valve configured to control communication between the cylinder chamber and the pump port and the tank port; and a controller configured to control motion of the module by controlling operation of the control valve based on a detection result from the state-quantity detector.
Claim 8. The module robot according to claim 1, wherein the fluid pressure cylinder is a liquid pressure cylinder, a supply-discharge port selectively connectable to a liquid pressure source and a tank is formed in an outer surface of the cylinder block, and the cylinder block is formed with a passage configured to connect the supply-discharge port with the cylinder chamber.
Claim 9. The module robot according to claim 2, wherein the module robot is configured by coupling at least two of the modules, the modules being identical.
Claim 10. The module robot according to claim 3, wherein the cylinder block of the first module is formed with a joint hole into which a joint tool is inserted, the joint tool being configured to connect the cylinder block with the first link or the second link of the second module.
